name: PerfMon
tagline: Windows 11 Task Manager & Precision Telemetry Suite
short_description: A native macOS system monitor with selectable desktop widget previews, eight graph styles, optional adaptive network scaling, process monitoring, disk and network topology, and a custom menu bar builder.
spotlight_description: PerfMon 1.5.1 adds a visual gallery with six optional widget presets, Cards presentation, eight graph styles, and adaptive or fixed network graph scaling. Existing widgets retain Classic and Legacy defaults. Monitor CPU, memory, disks, networks and available GPU telemetry with per-device and process scopes.
